content.content: The crate is listed on crates.io under keywords `jj`, `decision-graph`, `vcs`, `cli`, `agents` and categories `command-line-utilities`, `development-tools`.
content.rationale: Discovery is its own choice: the keywords name the niche — jj-backed decision graphs — and the categories put the crate where a CLI is looked for, so someone who has never heard of deccy can find it.
